title: Daily Internal Bar Strength dip buy in 200-day uptrend

source.title: Internal Bar Strength IBS Strategy (TradingView open-source script description)

rule_summary: All signals from closed daily candles (UTC) built from 1h data, executed at the next 1h open. IBS(d) = (close - low) / (high - low) of the daily candle (skip the day if high equals low). ENTRY: a daily candle closes with IBS < 0.2 AND daily close > SMA(200 days) of daily closes AND no open position. EXIT: a daily candle closes with IBS >= 0.8, or daily close falls 10% below entry price (hard stop checked on closed daily bars). No re-entry on the same day as exit. Source uses 0.2/0.8 thresholds without a trend filter; the 200-day filter is a standard textbook addition. Long only, one position, whole balance.
mechanism: A daily close near the low of its range reflects forced or impatient selling (liquidations, stop runs, panic market orders) that pushes price past short-term fair value; liquidity providers who bid into it collect the bounce as the next day's flow normalises. The 200-day filter avoids buying persistent downtrends. Source gives no mechanism beyond mean reversion of close location.
